'''Jalindas Renliss''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who acted as one of the managers of [[House Renliss]] alongside her sister [[Gratina Renliss]].
